title: Acyclicity of the bounded gate list
statement: Let $F$ be a layered Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and a unique output. Suppose every layer has finitely many nodes and every gate operation is either the identity, NOT, or an unbounded fan-in AND. For every natural number $m$, the list formed from the first $m$ layers of gates is acyclic: every source index of the gate at position $i$ is less than $n+i$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit over $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ with input type $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$ and output type $\mathrm{Unit}$
Every layer has finitely many nodes
Every gate operation belongs to the stated standard gate set
The conclusion holds for every natural number $m$
